summary: The registrant BMO Commercial Mortgage Securities LLC filed a Form 8-K to disclose a routine special servicer transition under a CMBS pooling and servicing agreement. Effective September 1, 2026, C-IV Asset Management LLC succeeded Greystone Servicing Company LLC as special servicer for the Citigroup Commercial Mortgage Trust 2022-GC48, which services the 79 Fifth Avenue mortgage loan held by BMO 2022-C2 Mortgage Trust. The filing attaches the Assignment and Assumption Agreement. This is a contractual administrative matter involving no change in security ownership, capital structure, or corporate control. It is not a special situation; rather, it is routine servicing personnel/entity notification required by the PSA.
